resources.string: Waiting to detect your registered Sesame over Bluetooth

Auto Unlock uses the Geofence API to detect when you leave the area you set, even while the app is closed or in the background. Leaving the area only arms Auto Unlock. Your door unlocks only after this phone connects to your registered Sesame over nearby Bluetooth. Select “Allow all the time” for Location in system settings. You can turn Auto Unlock off at any time.
